composition.overlay_guidance: Use dark upper and right regions for system UI. Depicted terrain is generic; select by star color, not planet type.

usage_constraints: Pre-rendered illustration, not an equirectangular texture or a rotatable planet map.
Keep game rules and selection logic separate from visual details.
Preserve procedural fallback and offline file:// image loading when integrating.
Star color is the game category; green and purple are fictional art cues. In the repository purple denotes a neutron star.
